how: Synthesized: one Slack message (bold, italic, strikethrough, link, inline code, a standard :tada: emoji, a workspace custom emoji, a nested bullet list, a quote and a code block) selected and copied in Slack desktop.
notes:
SYNTHESIZED from the markup Slack renders (c-mrkdwn__* classes, data-stringify-* attributes). Key traps: custom emoji arrive as (alt is the colon-name), standard emoji as (the plain text has the Unicode glyph), code block is 
, quote is 
, lists are 
    . Slack desktop is Electron, so HTML carries Chrome's  prefix. Slack also writes a private "slack/texty" entry (JSON of rich-text ops) into org.chromium.web-custom-data that is not reproduced. Unsure about the exact plain-text rendering of nested bullets (this uses • and ◦ with indentation).
